get_account_settings.description: Get the account's Lambda limits (code storage, concurrency) and current usage in the connection's region.
get_account_settings.name: get_account_settings

account_limit.description: Account limits: TotalCodeSize, CodeSizeUnzipped, CodeSizeZipped, ConcurrentExecutions, and UnreservedConcurrentExecutions.

get_function.description: Get a function's configuration, code location, tags, and reserved-concurrency settings.
get_function.name: get_function

parameters.description: The name or ARN of the function.
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.description: Optional version number or alias name.
parameters.name: qualifier

code.description: The deployment package details, including a presigned Location URL and RepositoryType.

concurrency.description: Reserved concurrency setting, or null when none is configured.

configuration.description: A Lambda function's configuration as returned by AWS (PascalCase keys such as FunctionName, FunctionArn, Runtime, Handler, Role, MemorySize, Timeout, LastModified, Version, State, and PackageType).

invoke_function.description: Invoke a Lambda function with an optional JSON payload, synchronously (RequestResponse) or asynchronously (Event).
invoke_function.name: invoke_function

parameters.description: The name, version/alias-qualified name, or ARN of the function to invoke (e.g. 'my-function').
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.description: JSON object passed to the function as the event. Leave empty to invoke with no input.
parameters.name: payload

parameters.description: RequestResponse waits for the function and returns its output; Event queues an asynchronous invocation; DryRun validates parameters and permissions without running the function.
parameters.name: invocation_type

parameters.description: Set to Tail to include the last 4 KB of the function's execution log in 'log_result' (RequestResponse only).
parameters.name: log_type

parameters.description: Optional version number or alias name to invoke a specific published version of the function.
parameters.name: qualifier

parameters.description: Optional base64-encoded data (up to 3,583 bytes) passed to the function in the client context object.
parameters.name: client_context

function_error.description: 'Handled' or 'Unhandled' when the function returned an error; null on success.

log_result.description: Decoded execution log tail when log_type is Tail; null otherwise.

payload.description: The function's response, parsed as JSON when possible (otherwise the raw string). Null for a DryRun invocation or an empty response.

status_code.description: HTTP status of the invocation (200 for RequestResponse, 202 for Event, 204 for DryRun).

list_functions.description: List the Lambda functions in the connection's region, with pagination.
list_functions.name: list_functions

parameters.description: Set to 'ALL' to include all published versions of each function in addition to the latest.
parameters.name: function_version

parameters.description: For a $LATEST listing, the region to filter Lambda@Edge functions by (e.g. 'us-east-1' or 'ALL').
parameters.name: master_region

parameters.description: Maximum number of functions to return (1–10000).
parameters.name: max_items

parameters.description: Pagination token from a previous response's 'next_marker' to fetch the next page.
parameters.name: marker

items.description: A Lambda function's configuration as returned by AWS (PascalCase keys such as FunctionName, FunctionArn, Runtime, Handler, Role, MemorySize, Timeout, LastModified, Version, State, and PackageType).

next_marker.description: Pagination token for the next page, or null if there are no more results.

list_versions_by_function.description: List the published versions of a Lambda function.
list_versions_by_function.name: list_versions_by_function

parameters.description: The name or ARN of the function.
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.description: Maximum number of versions to return (1–10000).
parameters.name: max_items

parameters.description: Pagination token from a previous response's 'next_marker' to fetch the next page.
parameters.name: marker

next_marker.description: Pagination token for the next page, or null if there are no more results.

versions.description: The function versions in this page.

items.description: A Lambda function's configuration as returned by AWS (PascalCase keys such as FunctionName, FunctionArn, Runtime, Handler, Role, MemorySize, Timeout, LastModified, Version, State, and PackageType).

description: Invoke and manage AWS Lambda serverless functions: run functions synchronously or asynchronously with a JSON payload, list and inspect functions and their versions, and check account limits and usage.
